name: Dynamic YouTube
description: Vlog, gaming, reaction: tight cuts, subtitles, zooms and sound effects to hold attention.
structure: hook (the best moment, 10-20 s) → title → chronological sections → conclusion
rules:
# Dynamic YouTube
- Open with a hook: the strongest moment or the video's promise, in 10 to 20 s. No slow intro.
- Keep the story: whole passages with their context, in order. Cut everything that doesn't move things forward or get a laugh.
- Pacing: silences cut, a visual change every 5 to 10 s (zoom, text, sound effect, shot change).
- Snappy zooms on strong reactions, short sound effects synced to events, no spamming.
- Background music matched to each section, changed when the mood changes.
- Subtitles in short meaningful groups, never before the speech.
- YouTube chapters on the first shot of each section.
